# Role Access Matrix (refined, with owning agent)

## Table Structure
- **Table Header Row**: Contains four columns with the following labels:
  - Column 1: "Role"
  - Column 2: "Sees"
  - Column 3: "Never sees"
  - Column 4: "Primary agent(s) available to this role"

## Table Rows (Role Entries)
### 1. Super Admin
- **Role**: Super Admin
- **Sees**: All schools/tenants, billing, system health, global automation config, Discovery Engine proposals across tenants
- **Never sees**: N/A
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: All agents (oversight mode)

### 2. School Admin / Principal / Director
- **Role**: School Admin / Principal / Director
- **Sees**: Whole-school data, Automation Control Centre, Digital Twin simulator, Automation Activity Log, Discovery Engine proposal queue
- **Never sees**: Other schools' data
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: All domain agents (approval authority), Discovery Agent, Concierge Agent

### 3. Teacher
- **Role**: Teacher
- **Sees**: Only her assigned classes/sections/subjects, her students' records, her timetable, her own leave/payroll
- **Never sees**: Other teachers' classes, whole-school finance/HR, admissions pipeline
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: Attendance Agent, Academic-Risk Agent (own classes only), Concierge Agent (scoped)

### 4. Student
- **Role**: Student
- **Sees**: Own timetable, grades, attendance, fee status, assignments
- **Never sees**: Any other student's or staff's data
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: Concierge Agent (own-record scope only, e.g. AI tutor)

### 5. Parent
- **Role**: Parent
- **Sees**: Own child(ren) only
- **Never sees**: Other families' data, staff/school-wide operations
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: Concierge Agent (own child scope), Finance Agent (own dues), Communication Agent (inbound)

### 6. Reception / Front Office
- **Role**: Reception / Front Office
- **Sees**: Visitor log, enquiry tracker, gate pass, minimal student directory
- **Never sees**: Grades, HR, financial ledgers
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: Admissions Agent (lead intake), Concierge Agent (scoped)

### 7. IT
- **Role**: IT
- **Sees**: System health, account admin, integration/licence tracker, audit logs, automation error queue
- **Never sees**: Academic content, financial ledgers
- **Primary agent(s) available to this role**: Discovery Agent (technical error patterns), Concierge Agent (scoped)
